HediffDef.label: vital resistance therapy
HediffDef.description: A temporary anti-Wraith treatment that disrupts the biological handoff used during life-force feeding. The protection lasts about five days. It does not make the patient immune: feeding can still succeed at sharply reduced strength, while some attempts are rejected violently enough to injure the feeding link.

HediffDef.label: vital resistance strain
HediffDef.description: The patient's metabolism is being forced to maintain the unstable anti-feeding state. Movement, manipulation and awareness are mildly impaired while the initial treatment stress passes.

HediffDef.label: life-force rejection crisis
HediffDef.description: A Wraith feeding attempt collided with active vital resistance and the victim's metabolism violently rejected the transfer. The extraction failed, but the rejection has temporarily destabilised movement, manipulation and consciousness.

HediffDef.label: feeding-link backlash
HediffDef.description: The Wraith's feeding link recoiled from a victim under active vital resistance. Awareness, sight and fine control are impaired while the psychic-biological feedback dissipates.
